package.name: kontrolem_controller_plugins
package.description: Kontrol'Em v2 discovery bridge (M16): exports the shipped control-law factories (kontrolem_controllers) as pluginlib plugins under the kontrolem_control::ControllerFactory base class, so the runtime finds each law by name at load time. This is the ONLY place pluginlib touches the controller stack besides the L4 runtime — keeping kontrolem_control and kontrolem_controllers ROS-free. A third-party law ships its own package like this one and drops in with zero edits to the runtime.
